titleArabic: Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada
titleEnglish: Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada — Traditional

verses.ar:
Be-bandagi, urooj kiya, banda kar diya
Taara mere naseeb ka, tabinda kar diya
Itni badi huzoor ki banda-nawaaziyan
Mujhko mere sawaal ne sharminda kar diya
verses.en:
Without devotion, He elevated me and made me His servant
The star of my fortune He made brilliant and shining
So great is the Prophet's grace upon his servants
My own question has left me ashamed

verses.ar:
Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada
Jo Karam Mujpe Mere Nabi Ne Kiya
verses.en:
How can I give thanks for this mercy
That my Prophet showed to me

verses.ar:
Gham-e-ashiqui se pehle, mujhe kaun jaanta tha
Teri zaat ne banaadi, meri zindagi fasaana

Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada...

Khaalik ne mujhko meri talab se sivaa diya
Sarmaaya-daar-e-ishq-e-Muhammad bana diya…
Is Karam Ka Karoon Shukr Kaise Ada
Jo Karam Mujpe Mere Nabi Ne Kiya
Main Sajata Tha Sarkar Ki Mehafile
Mujko Har Gam Se Rab Ne Bari Kar Diya
verses.en:
Before the sorrow of love, who even knew me?
Your very being transformed my life into a legend.

How can I give thanks for this mercy

The Creator bestowed upon me far more than I had ever sought—
He made me the possessor of the wealth of love for Muhammad.
How can I give thanks for this mercy
That my Prophet showed to me
I used to adorn the gatherings of the beloved
And the Lord freed me from every grief

verses.ar:
Lamha Lamha Hai Mujpar Nabi Ki Ata
Dosto Or Mangu Main Maula Se Kya
Kya Ye Kam Hai Ke Mere Khuda Ne Muje
Apne Mehbub Ka Ummati Kar Diya
verses.en:
Every moment the Prophet's blessing is upon me
My friends, what more could I ask of the Lord?
Is it not enough that my God has made me
A follower of His Beloved?

verses.ar:
Zikr Sarkar Ki Hai Bari Barkate
Jab liya naam-e-Nabi, meinen dua se pehle
Ho gayi mujhpe ataa, meri khataa se pehle…
Zikr Sarkar Ki Hai Bari Barkate
Mil Gai Rahate Azamate Rifa-Ate
Main Gunahgaar Tha Be-Amal Tha Magar
Mustafa (ﷺ) Ne Muje Jannati Kar Diya
verses.en:
In the remembrance of the beloved are immense blessings
When I invoked the name of the Prophet before offering my supplication,
His grace descended upon me—even before my own shortcomings could be considered.
In the remembrance of the beloved are immense blessings
Repose, greatness and elevation were granted
I was sinful, I had no deeds — yet
Mustafa ﷺ made me worthy of Paradise

verses.ar:
Joh Dar e Mustafa ke ghada ho gaye
Dekhte dekhte kya se kya ho gaye
Aisi chasme karam ki hai sarkar ne
Mujh gada ko sakhi ne sakhi kar diya
verses.en:
I stood at the threshold of Mustafa;
In the blink of an eye, I was completely transformed.
Such is the grace bestowed by the Master—
He turned a wretched, unworthy soul like me into someone of worth.

verses.ar:
Koi mayus lauta na darbar se
Joh bhi manga mila mere sarkar se
Sadqe jau niyazi mai lajpal ke
Dono aalam me mujh ko sakhi kar diya
verses.en:
No one ever returned disappointed from his court;
Whatever was asked for, was granted by my Master.
I dedicate my very self to the Generous One—
He has made me prosperous in both the worlds.
